tax.text: She supported funding Inflation Reduction Act investments by increasing taxes on the wealthiest Americans and corporations.
tax.quote: It is fully paid for by ensuring that the very wealthiest Americans and corporations pay their fair share in taxes.

schools.text: She supports federal investment in public schools, early education, and Head Start.
schools.quote: Public education is the foundation of our democracy. Federal investments need to meet the needs of our children and families in every district around the country.

safety.text: She joined the Massachusetts delegation in announcing funding that included a community-based violence-intervention project.
safety.quote: $275,000 for BMA TenPoint to establish a community-based violence and crime intervention and reduction project

immigration.text: Clark supports a pathway to citizenship for undocumented Americans and legal protections for Dreamers and TPS recipients.
immigration.quote: That means fixing our broken, overwhelmed immigration system and forging a pathway to citizenship for undocumented Americans.

gender.text: She denounced a bill that would ban transgender children from school sports.
gender.quote: This is not a problem in our communities, on our sports fields, for our children.

energy.text: Clark supports climate investments intended to cut carbon pollution while lowering energy bills.
energy.quote: With our game-changing Inflation Reduction Act, Democrats enacted the largest climate investment in history — putting us on track to slash carbon pollution by 40 percent this decade.

voting.text: She denounced a bill requiring voters to prove citizenship in person and called it voter suppression.
voting.quote: This is a minefield of red tape that you have put in front of women and American citizens and their right to vote.
